info.title: API.SH: HiBid
info.description: The HiBid API from API.SH: public HiBid data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A HiBid auction and one page of its catalog: name, description, status, lot and open-lot counts, bidding open and close times, event dates, bid type, buyer's premium, bid increments, shipping and pickup, payment, terms, location, accepted cards and the auction house (name, city, state, website), then 25 lots per page with the search filters and sorts, and category facets. Pass `id`, `url`, or `q` with `latest=true` (the auction of the first current search result).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hibid-auction

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Auction id (auction.id of a lot, or the number in a hibid.com/catalog/... link).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Instead of id: a hibid.com/catalog/... link.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words: with latest=true the auction of the first current search result; otherwise searches within the auction's lots.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: use the auction of the first search result for q.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: Near this US or Canadian ZIP / postal code.

parameters.name: miles
parameters.description: Distance from zip in miles (needs zip).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Lot status (default: open and upcoming).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Auction type.

parameters.name: min_bid
parameters.description: Lowest minimum bid (the amount the next bid must reach).

parameters.name: max_bid
parameters.description: Highest minimum bid (the amount the next bid must reach).

parameters.name: shipping
parameters.description: true: only lots with shipping offered.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country name, e.g. United States or Canada.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Two-letter state or province code, e.g. NY.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Result page (1 = first).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
An auction company on HiBid: name, address, city, state, postal code, country, website, logo and profile link, then its open auctions (25 per page) with name, dates, status, lot count, location and bidding terms. Pass `id` (or `url`), and `next_page` back as `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hibid-auctioneer

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The auction company id, e.g. 87744.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A hibid.com/company/... link (used instead of id).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number of its auctions (1 = first).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hibid-categories

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: Category id whose subcategories to list (empty = top level).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One HiBid lot: title, description, estimate, quantity, status, high bid, minimum next bid and the next bid steps, bid count, buy-now price, price realized for closed lots, time left, soft close, every photo, categories, and the auction (dates, terms, buyer's premium, bid increments, shipping and pickup, payment, location, auction house). Pass `id`, `url`, or `q` with `latest=true` (first current search result).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hibid-lot

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Lot id (id of a search result, or the number in a hibid.com/lot/... link).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Instead of id: a hibid.com/lot/... link.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: With latest=true: search words; the first current search result is used (the search filters also apply).

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: run the search and use its first result.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A HiBid lot's bid history as the site shows it: each bid amount with the number of bids at that amount and its time, highest first, plus the high bid and total bids. Bidders are never named.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hibid-lot-bids

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Lot id or a hibid.com/lot/<id>/... link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.note: Times are as the site shows them (the auction's local time).

get.description:
Search lots across HiBid auctions: title, lot number, current high bid, minimum next bid, bid count, buy-now price, time left and closing time, status, shipping, photo and the auction and auction house, with category facets. 25 lots per page, up to 400 pages; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hibid-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category id (facets.categories[].id), e.g. 40118 for Coins & Currency.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: Near this US or Canadian ZIP / postal code.

parameters.name: miles
parameters.description: Distance from zip in miles (needs zip).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Lot status (default: open and upcoming).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Auction type.

parameters.name: min_bid
parameters.description: Lowest minimum bid (the amount the next bid must reach).

parameters.name: max_bid
parameters.description: Highest minimum bid (the amount the next bid must reach).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
